claims.sentence: Students, postgraduates, teachers, and staff may use the University’s means of individualization to denote a link between an event, project, publication, product, work, or service and the University only after obtaining prior written consent from the official authorized to make decisions on intellectual property
To request this permission, you must send a corresponding application to the MCTT
Authorized officials may grant permission for a specific category of cases, such as publications, editions, or projects
Using official University document letterheads in the manner established by local regulatory acts
Using them in official and periodic University publications, on the corporate Bitrix portal, and on other University websites
Denoting events, publications, products, works, or services conducted or performed within University projects and/or in accordance with the University’s contractual obligations

Students, postgraduates, teachers, and staff may use the name of a structural subdivision to denote a link between an event, project, publication, product, work, or service and that subdivision only after obtaining prior written consent from the head of that subdivision (or another official authorized by the head) and prior written consent from the official authorized to make intellectual property decisions

Additional prior written consent from the intellectual property official is required if the subdivision name is used in paid relations with third parties or in the interests of third parties, including advertising their events, projects, goods, works, or services
Using official letterheads of the subdivision (if the subdivision’s regulation provides for such letterheads) in the manner established by local regulatory acts
Using it in official and periodic University publications, on the corporate portal, and on other University websites
Using it in other cases provided by decisions of the subdivision head

If you use the University’s means of individualization in mass media or audiovisual works, including when responding to requests from media or audiovisual producers, you must coordinate this use with the University’s Public Relations Department according to the procedure set by organizational and administrative acts
When preparing and publishing works where copyright belongs to the University, you must include a copyright notice in the form “© ANO VO “Universitet Innopolis”, year of publication”
This notice must be placed on the title page or second page of the publication
This notice must be placed on the cover and material carriers of software or databases, as well as on the visual image appearing on a computer screen when running or accessing them
This notice must be placed on the cover, material carriers, and credits of audiovisual works
You may use the University’s or a subdivision’s name to denote your position or the educational organization where you are studying, provided you follow internal rules and local acts on affiliation
This use must not allow the conclusion that the University or subdivision is responsible for your events, projects, products, works, or services

You may also include links to University-supported research projects in your publications, where the content of the link is determined by local regulatory acts and University contracts with the author governing the project
